desc: Implement single-file solution: read S, compute n and revS=S[::-1].
Build T = revS + '#' + S using a separator outside A-Z, compute KMP prefix function pi iteratively for T.
Let L = pi[-1], k = n - L, answer = S + revS[n - k:], print to stdout.
Verify against samples ABC->ABCBA, Z->Z, TREE->TREERT, and edge cases (all-same letters, already-palindrome S).
